customers.title: Customers
customers.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, company, account #, email, or phone…

empty.title: No customers yet
empty.description: Add a customer to start sending estimates and invoices. You can also bulk-import via the IIF importer in Accounting.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.voidConfirm: Void invoice {{number}}? A reversing journal entry will be posted.

empty.title: No invoices yet
empty.description: Create your first invoice to start billing customers. Posting an invoice automatically writes a balanced JE (DR A/R, CR Revenue).

new.title: New Invoice
new.needCustomer: You need at least one active customer before creating an invoice. Add one in the Customers tab.
new.itemPickerTitle: Pick an item to auto-fill description, price, account, taxable
new.taxEnabledTitle: Apply the selected tax rate to this line
new.taxDisabledTitle: Pick a tax rate below to enable
new.taxHint: Tick the Tax box on each line that should be taxed; tax = sum of those × rate.

invoiceDetail.label: Invoice
invoiceDetail.voidedOn: Voided on {{date}} (reversing JE posted; A/R restored).
invoiceDetail.voidConfirm: Void invoice {{number}}? A reversing journal entry will be posted; the original entry stays intact for the audit trail.

estimates.title: Estimates
estimates.blurb_one: {{count}} on file. Quotes don't post to the ledger; once accepted, click "Convert to invoice" to create the corresponding A/R invoice in one shot.
estimates.blurb_other: {{count}} on file. Quotes don't post to the ledger; once accepted, click "Convert to invoice" to create the corresponding A/R invoice in one shot.
estimates.emptyHint: No estimates yet. Click "+ New estimate" above.

convert.title: Convert to invoice
convert.description: Creates a new posted A/R invoice (DR A/R, CR revenue per line) and locks this estimate from further edits. Estimate {{number}} · {{total}}

items.title: Items / services
items.blurb: Items pre-fill the description, price, and GL account on invoice + bill lines so a 5-second line entry stays a 5-second line entry.
items.emptyHint: No items yet. Click "+ New item" above.
items.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate "{{name}}"? Existing invoices/bills that used it stay intact.

form.accountHint: At least one of <0>Income account</0> or <1>Expense account</1> is required so the item knows where to post.

statements.title: Customer statements
statements.description: Generate a printable A/R statement of account per customer for the period below. Lists every active customer with non-zero activity in the period or a non-zero balance — preview the targets first, then download one or all as PDFs.
statements.none: No customers had activity or open balances in this period.
statements.downloadHint: Each statement opens as a separate file in your downloads. Allow multiple downloads in the browser prompt if it asks.

taxRates.title: Tax rates
taxRates.description: Configure sales tax rates per jurisdiction. Each rate can be applied to invoice lines via the "Taxable" checkbox; the invoice posting service computes tax = sum(taxable lines) × (rate / 100) and credits Sales Tax Payable.
taxRates.empty: No tax rates yet. Add one above.
